name: crystal_cavern

emotion_styles.hope: bright inner light blooming through crystals, wondrous hope
emotion_styles.sad: dim cave with cold blue gleams, echoing drips, quiet solitude
emotion_styles.peace: still underground lake reflecting soft crystal glow, hushed calm

camera_styles: slow glide through a glittering tunnel
wide reveal of a vast chamber
overhead view of an underground lake

stages.name: 光る洞窟
stages.prompt: anime cinematic illustration, dark cave walls studded with glowing amethyst and aquamarine crystals, soft inner light, sparkling dust, mysterious depth

stages.name: 結晶の面
stages.description: 光が宝石の中で折れる
stages.prompt: beautiful anime macro scene, translucent crystal facets refracting prismatic light, sharp edges, rainbow caustics on stone, shallow depth

stages.name: 地底の湖
stages.prompt: anime cinematic landscape, vast underground lake reflecting luminous crystal clusters and stalactites, mist, perfect symmetry, quiet magical glow

stages.name: 大空洞
stages.description: 巨大な結晶柱が立ち並ぶ
stages.prompt: dramatic anime scene, colossal crystal pillars in an enormous cavern, beams of light crossing the dark, floating sparkles, epic scale

stages.name: 出口の光
stages.prompt: poetic anime scene, bright opening at the end of a crystal-lined tunnel, warm sunlight spilling over glittering walls, hopeful finale
